title: Service Recovery Standard — Kestrel Care Rewards Goodwill Points
content:
Goodwill points make up for a documented service failure and are credited to the patient's **Kestrel Care Rewards** membership.

## Standard

**G1 — Membership.** Goodwill points are credited only to a membership that is not closed, that is, one that is enrolled, active or suspended. A patient without a membership receives no goodwill points and no substitute.

**G2 — Reasons and amounts.** Each reason earns the level's amount for that reason:

- a **confirmed dispensing error** on a prescription whose handling class, under the Prescriptions terms, is eligible for the dispensing-error goodwill credit earns the dispensing-error amount;
- a **failed or lost prescription delivery** earns the delivery-failure amount;
- **another service failure documented in a Kestrel record** earns the service-recovery amount.

**G3 — Once per record and reason.** Each documenting record earns goodwill once per reason.

**G4 — Rolling allowance.** No goodwill is credited once the number of goodwill credits on the membership in the rolling 365 calendar days ending on, and including, the current day has reached the level's allowance.

**G5 — After crediting.** Goodwill points follow the ordinary conversion and expiry rules of Kestrel Care Rewards points.

## Amounts and allowance by level

| Level | Dispensing error (points) | Failed or lost prescription delivery (points) | Other documented service failure (points) | Goodwill credits allowed in any rolling 365 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member | 2500 | 1000 | 500 | 3 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | 2500 | 1000 | 500 | 3 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 3000 | 1500 | 750 | 4 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 5000 | 2500 | 1000 | 5 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly | 5000 | 2500 | 1000 | 6 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual | 5000 | 2500 | 1000 | 6 |

## Applying the standard (hypothetical cases)

| Case | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold membership, active, 2 goodwill credits in the last 365 days; a lost prescription delivery | 2 has not reached 4: 1500 points credited |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold membership, active, 4 goodwill credits in the last 365 days; a documented service failure | the allowance of 4 has been reached: no goodwill credited |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly membership, suspended, no goodwill credits in the last 365 days; a confirmed dispensing error on a prescription whose class is eligible for the credit | a suspended membership is not closed: 5000 points credited |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver membership, closed; a failed prescription delivery | the membership is closed: no goodwill credited |
| Patient with no Kestrel Care Rewards membership; a confirmed dispensing error | no goodwill points and no substitute |
| A record that has already earned goodwill for a failed delivery, presented again for the same reason | the record has already earned goodwill for that reason: nothing further |

**Condition summary for a credit:** a membership that is not closed, a reason listed in G2 documented by the record, no earlier goodwill on that record for that reason, and a rolling count below the level's allowance.
